display_long_description:
Traffic Moto VR: Bike Racing puts you on a motorcycle in first-person virtual reality and drops you into fast highway traffic. Use your VR controllers like handlebars, pull the trigger to accelerate, brake through tight gaps, hit boost, honk, and pop wheelies while chasing a higher score.

Overtake cars, buses, and trucks at speed to earn coins. The faster and cleaner you ride, the better the reward. Spend coins in the garage to unlock new bikes and levels, then return to the road for another run.

Game features:
-> First-person VR motorcycle racing
-> Controller-based handlebar steering
-> Highway traffic with cars, buses, and trucks
-> Boost, brake, horn, and wheelie controls
-> Coin rewards for speed and skillful riding
-> Garage bike selection and unlocks
-> Multiple race levels and drive modes
-> Time trial and score-chasing gameplay
-> Crash feedback and quick return to the garage

Built for riders who want a VR traffic racing game with simple controls, fast bike action, and arcade motorcycle racing feel.

Keep your hands steady, watch the lanes, dodge traffic, and become the fastest rider on the highway.
